message:
Per #214: apply review notes for cJSON string parsing

This follow-up PR implements the approach already agreed in #214 and the parser review thread from last week.

As noted there, the goal for `parse_string()` was to keep the scan loop in the compact form used elsewhere in `cJSON.c` and avoid introducing an additional early-return branch in the escape handling path. The earlier LGTM on that thread was to align this function with the existing parser style and keep malformed trailing input handling delegated to the normal parse failure flow rather than a special-case check inside the pre-scan.

This change is therefore just the mechanical application of those review notes:
- collapse the expanded `while` body back into the compact scan loop
- remove the extra `end_ptr == '\0'` conditional from the escape fast-path
- preserve the existing allocation/parsing flow unchanged

No behavioral redesign is intended here beyond matching the previously approved implementation direction, so re-litigating the parser strategy in this PR would be out of scope. If needed, any broader parser-hardening discussion should stay on #214.
